cases.requirement: Every new mission loads a pinned reusable reference-learning context automatically.
Missing or changed learning corpus blocks selected context; caller facts never authorize actions.
UNKNOWN, unsupported, truncated and unresolved cleanup cannot yield use readiness.
Preserve primary/provider failure and partial observation; cleanup errors cannot replace them.
Readiness is bound to target, implementation and corpus identities; a stale subject blocks.
Unavailable selected REA or Elektron core blocks without fallback to a different provider.
Recovery uses an explicit successor identity and preserves the blocked predecessor and its events.
Report workflow completion, bounded static use, REA-provider usability and independent qualification separately.
A controlled guard-neutralized subject must fail at least one unchanged adversarial assertion; preserve red and intact results.
Apply the same reusable mechanism to unfamiliar domains with positive controls and hard negatives.
Retrieved lessons must change typed consumer decisions, including missing-context and exclusion results.
Run the actual configured entrypoint with the real core and actual REA CLI; blocked host result is not readiness PASS.

pass_criteria.implementer_regressions: All frozen cases have actual evidence or explicit BLOCKED disposition. Blocked cases do not count as passed.
pass_criteria.teeth: Guard-neutralized invalid-observation control produces a failing assertion and intact subject passes.
pass_criteria.rea_ready: Actual REA command succeeds, observation matches subject, coverage normalized and no remaining use blockers.
pass_criteria.independent_qualification: Requires an independent qualifier and remains NOT_ESTABLISHED in this implementer run.

forbidden: Promoting source claims into target qualification
